item.title: Maine leaders pitch solutions to enhance grid as temperatures drop and electricity prices soar
item.description: Natural gas prices spiked to their highest level ever in New England in January, driving up the cost of electricity. Experts said the state should hasten energy project permitting and transmission interconnection to bring electricity prices down long-term.
